summary: Iteration 91: Dorsi Smart Cushion with CDC games and BLE integration. Backend 100% pass (9/9 tests). Frontend verified: bilan multi-step flow, program calendar with CDC games (Jeu des Moutons, Bulles de Savon, Equilibre Proprioceptif), free play section. Fixed bug in dorsi_routes.py (now variable used before definition).

integration_issues.issue: Intermittent loading issue - page sometimes gets stuck on 'Chargement...' spinner during navigation. Works correctly when page fully loads.
integration_issues.notes: Auth token may not persist properly between page navigations. Successfully renders when data loads.

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: dorsi_routes.py line 157 - 'now' variable was used before definition in create_program endpoint. Moved 'now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()' to line 147.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created bilans and programs via API calls
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dorsi feature working with CDC spec games. Backend routes at /app/backend/routes/dorsi_routes.py. Frontend pages /dorsi-bilan and /dorsi-program. BLE integration via useDorsiBLE hook falls back to simulation mode without HeloKine01 device. Free play section now visible at top of program page. Games: Jeu des Moutons (mobility), Bulles de Savon (endurance), Equilibre Proprioceptif (proprioception).

backend: POST /api/dorsi/bilan - create bilan works with existing program
POST /api/dorsi/program - replaces existing active program (old marked 'replaced')
GET /api/dorsi/programs - returns all including replaced programs
CDC game names in program generation: Moutons, Bulles, Proprioception
frontend: /dorsi-bilan: BLE connection UI with 'Connecter' button, simulation mode indicator
/dorsi-bilan: Multi-step flow - intro → taring → 4 directions → pain → radar chart
/dorsi-program: 'Jeux libres' section with 3 CDC games accessible anytime
/dorsi-program: 10-day calendar showing CDC game names per session

bug_fix_applied.issue: 'now' variable used before being defined in create_program endpoint
bug_fix_applied.fix: Moved datetime assignment to before existing program check
